subject.title: fix(google): support GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID for Vertex AI

question: Should OpenClaw accept `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as a supported Google Vertex project alias across auth evidence and runtime resolution?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proven, but env/config surfaces are high-bar and upstream `@google/genai` only reads `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` directly, so this OpenClaw-specific alias needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the additive alias
options.body: Land the PR after normal exact-head gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

options.title: Ask for provider-owner narrowing
options.body: Hold for docs wording, a different precedence order, or an auth-evidence-only shape before expanding runtime recognition.

options.title: Decline the alias
options.body: Close or request removal if maintainers want Google Vertex to stay aligned with upstream SDK env names only.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive alias
recommendation.body: Land the PR after normal exact-head gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Google provider credential work and merge history make this the best available owner for the env-surface decision.
